messages:
Sam (CS): Hey team, Aurora Credit pushed back on the SIG/CAIQ + bespoke form — they want: sample audit logs showing key rotation + HSM attestation snippet, a short repro for the 401 they saw on keystore export, and confirmation of our retention window. Deadline = Tue EOD. Can we assemble a minimal playbook?
Maria (SE): I can draft the questionnaire responses. For logs we should send a sanitized sample and write the repro steps. @Drew (Oncall) can you help with the 401 root cause? :eyes:
Drew (Oncall): Likely causes: expired service token or clock skew for the customer request. Need the request-id + tenant id to correlate. If they can share the failing curl and timestamp that helps.
Sam (CS): Provided example from customer: request-id=req_20260301_44ab, tenant=aurora-prod. Customer says the export curl was:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED"
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keystore/export
  -d '{"keystore": "cust-aurora-01"}'
```
They attached an ISO timestamp 2026-03-01T18:22:12Z.
Paul (Infra): I'll pull matching traces. Short repro we can give: 1) use an expired/mismatched token -> 401, 2) client clock >5s skew -> signature validation fail -> 401. I'll paste a redacted log snippet and the rotation event line.
Paul (Infra): Redacted log sample: 
```
[2026-03-01T18:21:59Z] tenant=aurora-prod event=keystore.rotate key_id=k-9f3d rotation_type=scheduled actor=system
[2026-03-01T18:22:13Z] tenant=aurora-prod request=req_20260301_44ab api=keystore.export status=401 reason=auth.failed
```
Paul (Infra): HSM attestation: we can supply the last quarterly attestation PDF and the CAIQ mappings for KMS controls. I'll attach links in the playbook.
Maria (SE): For retention window: confirm we store audit logs for 365 days by default for enterprise accounts; can provide an excerpt from the policy page. Sam, can you request permission from Aurora to accept redacted logs and the attestation PDF?
Sam (CS): Done — asked customer for explicit permission to share redacted logs + attestation by EOD Mon. Also asked them to try a fresh token and resend the failing request if possible.
infra-bot: Created ticket INF-7812 to collect logs + prepare redacted sample and attestation bundle (assignee: Paul).
Sam (CS): Thanks everyone — I'll update Aurora after Paul drops the bundle and Maria finalizes the SIG/CAIQ answers.
Maria (SE): I'll also include a 2-step repro note they can run locally: 1) generate token with TTL 1s then wait 2s and call export -> expect 401; 2) set client clock 1 min ahead and call export -> expect 401. Short, easy to reproduce. :+1:
Sam (CS): Perfect. Closing loop once INF-7812 has attachments.
